summary: FDM-printable compact Mini-ITX enclosure with motherboard/cooler, a conventional rear-panel dual-slot GPU bracket position, and a 160 x 80 x 40 mm 1U PSU that mounts directly to the screw-fixed rear panel without an internal cradle.

required_interfaces.description: Visually and structurally verify the top, Mini-ITX, conventional rear dual-slot GPU bracket, screw-fixed rear panel, direct rear-panel PSU interface and remaining magnet screw-hole patterns declared by the current CAD brief.
Fit and retain a standard 170 x 170 mm Mini-ITX motherboard with accessible rear I/O.
Fit the Thermalright AXP120-X67 envelope and preserve side-panel intake clearance.

Provide only a conventional two-slot GPU bracket position in the rear panel: two 18 x 120 mm expansion-slot apertures at 20.32 mm pitch and one M3 bracket retention point per slot. No printed GPU shelf, tail support, rear subframe, side receiver, side clamp, PCIe riser assembly or riser mounting hardware is included.

Mount the 160 x 80 x 40 mm compact 1U PSU directly to the screw-fixed rear panel without a printed cradle, preserving AC inlet access, airflow and cable routing. Model-specific PSU holes are intentionally excluded from this visual-draft deliverable and are drilled or added after PSU selection.
Provide one externally accessible power button with an internal path to the motherboard header.

assembly_story.installation: Place each foot directly under its corner-column axis, then fasten each independent column from below with one kit-selected M3 socket-cap screw passing through the foot and 3 mm base into the column; install the twelve 10 x 10 x 3 mm countersunk magnets for the front, left and right panels directly into the column pockets with centered M3 screws; mount the motherboard, secure the dual-slot GPU bracket at the conventional rear-panel slot position, add the chosen PSU's mounting pattern to the rear panel during final fabrication, mount the PSU directly to the rear panel, and fasten the rear panel to the two rear columns with four kit-selected M3 socket-cap screws.
assembly_story.maintenance: Pull off the magnetically retained front, left, or right service panel without tools. Remove four M3 screws to service the rear panel; the rear panel is not magnet-retained.

documents.description: Complete printable Mini-ITX enclosure assembly with four independently printable, underside-screwed corner columns
